name: Spencer County, KY
findings: Spencer County has 42 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (64% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Spencer County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Spencer County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
